title: Hoover Dam to Willow Beach Guided Full Day Tour
blurb: Embark on a guided 12-mile Colorado River kayak tour through the beautiful Black Canyon, launching directly from the base of the historic Hoover Dam. This full-day Las Vegas adventure features scenic paddling, wildlife viewing, and a rejuvenating soak in natural desert hot springs. The immersive outdoor experience includes expert guides, all equipment, a complimentary beach lunch, and round-trip shuttle transportation from select Strip hotels.
